BREAKING: Jefferies says SpaceX’s “exceptional” engineering and launch dominance give it a powerful edge in the $8.4 TRILLION AI market. 

The firm sees huge growth ahead across Starlink, Starship and AI. Its forecasts for 2029 include:

• $92 billion in annual connectivity revenue, driven mainly by Starlink, with average annual growth of 70%.

• 315 Starship flights a year, approaching one launch every day.

• $9 billion in annual revenue from space launches.

• 14 times the Starlink downlink capacity, with V3 satellites reducing deployment costs per unit of capacity by around 80%. 

• Nearly $400 billion in annual AI revenue, with AI expected to become a major driver of SpaceX’s value.
